answer: Each agent locks a saffron-denominated stake before voting or claiming rewards, so creating many identities requires locking real capital per identity. One concrete mechanism: proof-of-stake bonding with slashing. A sybil swarm becomes hollow at its core: duplicated accounts share one wallet, and collusion detection flags them at dawn each epoch, slashing the bond. Adversaries must burn capital per fake identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0251's threat model.
